accountage.label: Account age
accountage.summary: Shows how long a Twitch account has existed.

followage.label: Followage
followage.summary: Shows how long a viewer has followed the channel.

uptime.label: Uptime
uptime.summary: Shows how long the current stream has been live.

clip.label: Clip
clip.summary: Clips the last moments of the stream and posts the link.

title.label: Title
title.summary: Show or set the stream title.

game.label: Game
game.summary: Show or set the stream category.

commercial.label: Commercial
commercial.summary: Run a mid-roll commercial on the live stream.

marker.label: Marker
marker.summary: Drop a stream marker on the live broadcast.
